implementation.name: original-v2-checkpoint-recovery-timeline
implementation.scope: Original two-save schematic progress timeline, without physical time or progress units.
implementation.question: Why does failure cost both rework and recovery?

purpose: Observe save plateaus, discarded progress, vertical failure rollback, flat recovery, and resumed compute on the original timeline.
guard: No A/B staging workload. Completed saves advance durable progress; failure discards only progress after the last save; recovery remains flat.
